C6), keeping only N and E: study item 2m-1 = IPIP-NEO-120 item 5(m-1)+1, study item 2m = item 5(m-1)+2 -- which is exactly the odd-(N)/even-(E) alternation in the codes. Checked against the study's own scored columns in s002: 11 of 12 facet scores reproduce 928/928 from the live items with the canonical reverse key, and the Neuroticism total 928/928; per-item polarity matches the canonical key 48/48 (weakest: item 44 'Like to take it easy.' r=-0.01, item 34 'Enjoy being reckless.' r=+0.15). Two STUDY-SIDE scoring slips in derived columns (not in the IRW table, which excludes them): the study's N2 Anger column = Item 2 (E) + Items 15, 27 + (6 - Item 39), i.e. column 2 used where column 3 belongs (928/928; the correct-mapping sum matches only 195/928); and its Extraversion total reverse-scores item 30 'Take control of things.' (928/928 that way vs 246/928 canonical), although its own E3 column scores item 30 positively and item 30 correlates +0.43 with the rest of E. Neither affects the item mapping. NOT established: order among items sharing facet AND key (43 of 1128 item pairs exchangeable, e.g. Anger 3/15/27). option_text is the paper's own wording transcribed literally in lower case (1 'very inaccurate' .. 5 'very accurate'); the live data are stored raw (reverse-keyed items correlate negatively). instructions left blank: the paper publishes none.
